metadata.judge_brief: Avatar: conditional when src, fallback initials when not, size-based className map (sm/md/lg/xl), rounded-full.
Breadcrumbs: maps items, shows separator between, last item not clickable, others as Link if href.
ProductCard renders title, description, conditional image, links to href via Next.js Link or anchor.
ArticleCard renders title, description, conditional image, links to href via Next.js Link or anchor.
EventCard renders title, description, conditional image, links to href via Next.js Link or anchor.
ProfileCard renders title, description, conditional image, links to href via Next.js Link or anchor.
ListingCard renders title, description, conditional image, links to href via Next.js Link or anchor.
Generic ComboBox<T>: search input, filtered dropdown of items, click selects and calls onSelect. Generic over T.
ConfirmDialog: shows trigger, opens modal with title/description, confirm calls onConfirm (await if Promise), cancel closes. destructive=true styles confirm button red.
CopyButton with useState for copied flag, click handler calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(text), updates state, renders a button.
CopyButton with useState for copied flag, click handler calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(code), updates state, renders a button.
Stepper with increment + decrement buttons that update state via useState(0).
Votes with split up/down buttons that update state via useState({ up: 0, down: 0 }).
Generic DataTable<T>: thead from columns, tbody from data, calls render function if provided.
DropdownMenu: useState for open, click trigger toggles, maps items to clickable buttons calling onSelect.
NoOrdersState: empty illustration/icon, headline, description, CTA button calling onCta.
NoMessagesState: empty illustration/icon, headline, description, CTA button calling onCta.
NoProductsState: empty illustration/icon, headline, description, CTA button calling onCta.
NoResultsState: empty illustration/icon, headline, description, CTA button calling onCta.
IconButton: button with icon child, aria-label set to label, onClick handler.
Modal: returns null if not open, escape key handler, backdrop click closes, renders children. Uses portal or overlay.
Pagination: prev/next + page numbers, disables prev on page 1 / next on last page, navigates via router.push or anchor with page query param.
